raw_segments.text: I did not like this iteration of one idea, this strange recurrence of one image, and
I grew nervous as bedtime approached and the hour of the vision drew near. It was from
companionship with this baby phantom. I had been roused on that moonlight night when I
heard the cry, and it was on the afternoon of the day following I was summoned downstairs
by a message that someone wanted me in Mrs. Fairfax's room.
On repairing Thither, I found a man waiting for me, having the appearance of a gentleman's
